title: Grooving' with Diane
author: Jean Gorrindo
problems: Row 4 "partners meltdown swing": a dancer has to move 1.25 m in one beat, faster than a walk.
choices: A balance with a partner or neighbor holds both hands.
A meltdown swing starts with 4 beats of right-shoulder round, then swings.
A swing that ends facing down the hall is drawn ending facing across; the down the hall that follows turns the lines.
